<subject>Succession Plan</subject>
<body>
Darren:  
Congratulations on your well-earned promotion. Your leadership has been a key driver in making Tasman Ridge the top mining and logistics firm it is today, and I’m excited to see Tasman Ridge reach new milestones with you at the helm.  
Congratulations again, Robert Smith
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by John Hunt on  
12/11/2024 10:10 AM ---------------------------

Robert Stanley  
12/11/2024 06:02 AM

Sent by: Tasman Ridge Schneider  
To: All Tasman Ridge Worldwide  
cc:   

Subject: Succession Plan

I am pleased to announce that the Tasman Ridge Board has accepted my recommendation to appoint Darren Richmond as CEO, effective from their next meeting on 10 February 2025. Darren will also continue as President and COO. I will remain Chairman of the Board and work closely with Darren on the company’s strategic direction and daily operations.

Darren steps into this role as Tasman Ridge is performing strongly and primed for significant expansion. After 15 years as CEO, I am ready to focus on a different role.

Our succession plan has been clear for some time, allowing Darren and me to combine our strengths and build a company that consistently exceeds expectations. We look forward to continuing this partnership as Darren takes on greater responsibilities.

No other management changes or strategy shifts are planned.

Please join me in congratulating Darren. Here’s to a great 2025.
</quoted>
